dct_description_sm: Gut content of age-0 Boreogadus saida, Arctogadus glacialis, Liparis fabricii and Triglops nybelini from the Greenland Sea August-September 2017 were analyzed to study competitive interactions among the species, for inclusion in the following scientific article: Caroline Bouchard, Julek Chawarski, Maxime Geoffroy, Apasiri Klasmeier, Eva Friis Mller, Christian Mohn, Mette Dalgaard Agersted (accepted for publication) Interspecific competition and recruitment of age-0 fish in the Greenland Sea: the role of transport and preferred prey availability. Elementa: Science of the Anthropocene.
dct_title_s: Stomach content of 4, age-0 fish species from the Greenland Sea, August-September 2017
